acceptance.given: The complete current Consumer Manifest and repository call surface are loaded from the current checkout.

oracle.expected: A bidirectional reconciliation artifact proves every manifest entry maps to at least one repository caller and every VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing caller is represented in the manifest.
forbidden: Any caller in VDD, Acceptance, or workflow-model-routing is omitted.
oracle.observable: A machine-readable reconciliation report containing both manifest-to-caller and caller-to-manifest rows, with scope labels for VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing.

acceptance.then: The reconciliation is accepted only when both directions and all named scopes are complete.
acceptance.when: The Consumer Manifest reconciliation validator runs against the current repository.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Remove one repository caller or manifest entry from the reconciliation fixture; validation must report the unmatched side.
Provide a reconciliation artifact omitting VDD, Acceptance, or workflow-model-routing scope; validation must reject the incomplete scope coverage.

affected_subjects: Consumer Manifest entries and repository callers
slice_hint.behavior_change: Add or enforce bidirectional Consumer Manifest reconciliation against the real repository call surface, explicitly covering VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing consumers.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing manifest and caller schemas; rollback only the reconciliation enforcement.

slice_hint.state_transition: unreconciled manifest/call surface -> bidirectionally reconciled manifest with all required scopes
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validator exits success only when both mapping directions contain no unmatched entries and all three named consumer scopes are present.

acceptance.given: A verdict candidate, current source identity, and execution evidence are available.

oracle.expected: The verdict is accepted only when a validator derives it from current source identity and recorded execution evidence; assistant prose is ignored as evidence.
forbidden: A verdict passes with prose-only justification.
Evidence does not identify the current source or execution.
oracle.observable: A validator result containing source digest, execution evidence references, and a computed verdict independent of narrative text.

acceptance.then: The evidence-derived verdict is emitted with traceable source and execution identifiers.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Submit a verdict whose only support is assistant prose and no current source identity or execution evidence; validation must reject it.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require verdict computation to consume current source identity and real execution evidence, excluding assistant prose from the evidentiary path.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep verdict output fields backward compatible while requiring evidence fields.

slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A verdict is terminally valid only if source identity and execution evidence validate and narrative text contributes no decision input.

acceptance.given: A Replay Result reports success and includes a target snapshot reference.

oracle.expected: Independent snapshot verification executes and records a pass tied to the successful Replay Result; success is rejected when the snapshot check is absent, mismatched, or fails.
forbidden: A successful Replay Result lacks an independent snapshot verification.
Snapshot verification merely echoes the replay success flag.
oracle.observable: Replay Result payload contains an independently computed snapshot verification outcome with snapshot identity and verification evidence.

acceptance.then: The Replay Result is accepted only after the independent snapshot check passes.
acceptance.when: Replay Result finalization evaluates a successful replay.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Use a successful replay fixture with snapshot verification removed; runtime validation must fail the result.
Bind the result to a different snapshot identity than the independently verified snapshot; validation must reject the result.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add independent snapshot verification to successful Replay Result finalization and bind its outcome to the verified snapshot identity.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain existing Replay Result fields and add or preserve an explicit snapshot verification record.

slice_hint.state_transition: successful replay without independent snapshot proof -> successful replay with independently verified snapshot
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Success can be emitted only when the independently recomputed snapshot identity and verification status match the Replay Result binding.

acceptance.given: A detached positive Probe is launched as an independent process with a declared input binding and output channel.

oracle.expected: The process receives the declared bound inputs, and its produced outputs are captured and associated with the same execution identity; unbound or detached outputs fail validation.
forbidden: The positive Probe runs with unbound inputs.
The positive Probe produces outputs that are not bound to the execution result.
oracle.observable: Probe execution evidence records execution identity, serialized input binding, process result, and output binding, with matching identities.

acceptance.then: The detached positive Probe execution is accepted only when input and output bindings both match the execution identity.
acceptance.when: Detached positive Probe execution is requested and its result is collected.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the detached positive Probe without the declared input binding; the process-execution validator must report missing input binding.
Return output under a different execution identity; validation must reject the detached result as unbound.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure detached positive Probe process execution serializes and validates execution-bound inputs and associates outputs with the identical execution identity.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve worker command protocol while requiring explicit execution identity on input and output records.

slice_hint.state_transition: detached Probe execution with implicit/unbound I/O -> detached Probe execution with matching bound I/O
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Probe evidence is valid only when input binding and output binding carry the same execution identity as the process invocation.
